verdict.rationale: JMAP access is well evidenced: the open, patent-free standard with session discovery, OAuth/Bearer auth and push, plus Fastmail API tokens and an open-source/standards page. SMTP access is corroborated by a user sending through Fastmail SMTP with an SMTP-only app password, and IMAP is only implied by community mentions of an 'IMAP route' for migration. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of IMAP/SMTP client access to Fastmail, any evidence of standards-based export (e.g., mbox/EML, or contacts/calendar in vCard/iCal), and independent corroboration of lock-in-free migration out.
